pullRequests.title: Make the build and try tools run natively on Windows
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: windows-native
pullRequests.body:
The README says Windows works natively with Git Bash (bash tools/build.sh), but on a plain Windows install every compile failed:

cc.sh, build_libgcc.sh, build_libm.sh, compile_variants.sh and try_variants.py always call wine, which does not exist on Windows (the 32-bit compilers run directly there).
try_func.py writes Path.relative_to() into compile.sh, which gives backslashes on Windows; bash reads them as escapes, so the compile never runs (it reported COMPILE failed for every candidate, and…

pullRequests.title: [PAL-verified] Match 17 shared overlay functions (moby helpers)
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: pal-mobys-1
pullRequests.body:
Draft — needs an NTSC-U check before it can be merged.
17 shared overlay functions, matched against the PAL build (SCES-53285): each source compiles through tools/cc.sh to the PAL bytes, masked exactly like tools/audit_matches.py. I don't have an NTSC-U disc, so audit_matches.py, audit_relocs.py and progress/report.json could not be run on SCUS_974.65; that is why the progress check will fail here.

pullRequests.title: Match 21 shared overlay functions (moby helpers, part 2), verified on PAL
pullRequests.author: chistianh
pullRequests.head: pal-mobys-2
pullRequests.body:
Second batch from the same zone as #7 (moby/pvar helpers in shared overlay code).
All 21 functions compile with tools/cc.sh to the PAL (SCES-53285) bytes, masked like tools/audit_matches.py, checked from their final location in src/overlays/shared/. A deliberately broken copy was rejected by the same check. None of them exist in upstream main.
Same caveat as #7: not yet checked against SCUS_974.65 (audit_matches, audit_relocs and progress/report.json need the NTSC baserom).
